Description

SSL Lab has won funding for development of specific Satellite Technology & Research Lab (SSTRL) under the HEC’s National Center of GIS and Space Applications (NCGSA). Under this lab, the major project undertaken is a 3-U National CubeSat (ICUBE-N). All the major modules of the satellite will be developed in-house with the collaboration of other universities of Pakistan.
